metadata.question: Was the rainfall in Seattle between September through November in 2021 larger than that in 2020 and in 2019?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy (Collection, Date, Location). - Use CHIRPS Daily precipitation (UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY) for Sep 1–Nov 30 in 2019, 2020, 2021 over a 15 km buffer around Seattle (47.6062, -122.3321). If a year has 0 images, fallback to ERA5-LAND Daily Aggregated (ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR), converting total_precipitation_sum from meters to mm. 2. Masking strategy (Should I mask clouds? Or is the question about clouds?). - Clouds are not applicable to precipitation datasets. No cloud masking; we will validate via image counts and valid pixel counts. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3). - If collection size is 0 for both primary and fallback: C1. - If valid pixel count after summation is 0: C2. - If the computed total is null/NaN/negative: C3. - Otherwise compare totals: A if 2021 > 2020 and 2019, else B. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { function getInfoAsync(eeObj) { return new Promise((resolve, reject) => { eeObj.getInfo((res, err) => { if (err) reject(err); else resolve(res); }); }); } const region = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]).buffer(15000); const scale = 5000; async function analyzeYear(year) { const start = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 9, 1); const end = ee.Date.fromYMD(year, 12, 1); // exclusive // Primary: CHIRPS let source = 'CHIRPS'; let col = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(region) .select(['precipitation']); let n = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (n === 0) { // Fallback: ERA5-Land daily aggregated source = 'ERA5-LAND'; col = ee.ImageCollection('ECMWF/ERA5_LAND/DAILY_AGGR') .filterDate(start, end) .filterBounds(region) .select(['total_precipitation_sum']) .map(img => img.select('total_precipitation_sum').multiply(1000).rename('precipitation')); n = await getInfoAsync(col.size()); if (n === 0) { return { code: 'C1' }; } } const sumImg = col.sum(); // mm over period const countDict = await getInfoAsync(sumImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })); const px = countDict ? countDict['precipitation'] : null; if (!px || px === 0) return { code: 'C2' }; const meanDict = await getInfoAsync(sumImg.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: region, scale: scale, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true })); const totalMm = meanDict ? meanDict['precipitation'] : null; if (totalMm === null || !isFinite(totalMm) || totalMm < 0) return { code: 'C3' }; return { code: 'OK', images: n, pixels: px, totalMm: totalMm, source: source }; } try { console.log('Region: Seattle (15 km buffer). Scale: 5000 m'); console.log('Clouds: N/A for precipitation datasets'); const y2019 = await analyzeYear(2019); if (y2019.code !== 'OK') { console.log(`2019: ${y2019.code}`); console.log(y2019.code); return; } console.log(`2019: images=${y2019.images}, valid_px=${y2019.pixels}, total=${y2019.totalMm.toFixed(1)} mm [${y2019.source}]`); const y2020 = await analyzeYear(2020); if (y2020.code !== 'OK') { console.log(`2020: ${y2020.code}`); console.log(y2020.code); return; } console.log(`2020: images=${y2020.images}, valid_px=${y2020.pixels}, total=${y2020.totalMm.toFixed(1)} mm [${y2020.source}]`); const y2021 = await analyzeYear(2021); if (y2021.code !== 'OK') { console.log(`2021: ${y2021.code}`); console.log(y2021.code); return; } console.log(`2021: images=${y2021.images}, valid_px=${y2021.pixels}, total=${y2021.totalMm.toFixed(1)} mm [${y2021.source}]`); const cond = (y2021.totalMm > y2020.totalMm) && (y2021.totalMm > y2019.totalMm); console.log(`Check: 2021 > 2020 and 2019? ${cond ? 'true' : 'false'}`); console.log(cond ? 'A' : 'B'); } catch (err) { console.log(`Error: ${err && err.message ? err.message : err}`); console.log('D'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
